title: Personal Injury Paralegal
description:
Personal Injury Paralegal

Bristol

Salary up to 30,000 DOE

Yolk Recruitment is working with a national law firm looking to recruit a Personal Injury Paralegal to join its Serious & Catastrophic Injury team in Bristol.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with claimant Personal Injury experience who wants to develop their exposure to more complex, high-value injury work.

Rather than being expected to independently manage a significant caseload, you will work closely with senior members of the team, assisting with serious and catastrophic injury claims. The position would particularly suit a Paralegal, Legal Assistant or PI Case Handler looking to build their technical knowledge while learning directly from experienced serious injury specialists.

The role offers hybrid working, with two days per week in the Bristol office and three days working from home.

This is what you will be doing

As a Personal Injury Paralegal, your duties and responsibilities will include:
- Assisting senior case handlers with serious and catastrophic personal injury claims.
- Helping with the day-to-day progression and organisation of complex PI files.
- Collating medical records, evidence relating to liability and evidence supporting uninsured losses.
- Organising client and expert meetings and conferences with Counsel.
- Liaising with clients, insurers, expert witnesses, solicitors and other parties.
- Maintaining accurate case records and ensuring matters are progressed in line with relevant service standards.
- Participating in regular case and risk assessment meetings.

The experience you will bring to the team

You will bring the following experience to the Personal Injury team:
- Previous experience within claimant Personal Injury, either handling claims or assisting with a PI caseload.
- Experience using a legal case management system.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- A good approach to client care.
- An interest in developing your knowledge of serious and catastrophic injury work.

Previous litigation experience and experience using bundling software would be advantageous but aren't essential.

This is what you will get in return
- Salary up to 30,000 depending on experience.
- Hybrid working with only two days per week required in the Bristol office.
- Exposure to serious and catastrophic Personal Injury work.
- The opportunity to work closely with experienced senior case handlers.
- Training, development and routes towards further legal qualification.
- Annual leave and employee welfare benefits.
- Health cash plan and gym/lifestyle benefits.
- Employee recognition and referral schemes.
- A genuine opportunity to broaden your technical Personal Injury experience.

Are you up to the challenge?

title: IP Records Administrator / Records Paralegal
company: The Law Support Group - Agency - Permanent
description:
Records Administrator / IP Paralegal

The Opportunity

Our client, a well-established intellectual property firm, is looking for a detail-driven Records Administrator / Paralegal to join its busy formalities team. This role would suit an experienced IP records professional who enjoys accuracy, structure and working to strict deadlines. You'll support patent, design and trade mark matters from start to finish, keeping case records accurate and working closely with clients, fee earners and overseas associates. This position is full time hybrid, offering 40% remote working.

What You'll Be Doing
- Managing formalities across patent, design and trade mark applications, including filings, completion reminders, official communications, publications, fee payments, grants and certified copies
- Handling incoming post and electronic correspondence from clients and foreign associates, and recording deadlines and actions on the IP management system
- Identifying due dates in incoming correspondence and diarising them accurately
- Reviewing outgoing correspondence and updating case records to match
- Opening new case records from client instructions, checking data against online databases such as EPOLine, diarising deadlines and acknowledging instructions
- Recording filing details and checking them against filing receipts, arranging corrections where needed
- Updating case status as matters progress, including publication, grant or registration, oppositions, refusals, revocations and official actions
- Producing and sending standard correspondence related to the role
- Monitoring the daily critical deadlines list so fee earners are aware of same-day actions
- Taking on other tasks as needed to support the team

About You
- Highly organised, motivated and efficient
- Confident and self-assured
- Exceptional attention to detail, with accuracy maintained under pressure
- Able to multi-task and prioritise against strict legal deadlines
- Works well independently while also being a supportive, approachable team player
- Strong written and verbal communication skills at all levels

Desirable
- Experience using Inprotech or a similar IP records system
- 3+ years in a records or IP department
- Sound knowledge of EP and UK patent and trade mark procedures
- CIPA Patent Paralegal Course and/or CITMA Trade Mark Administrators Course (desirable, not essential)

Interested?

If you have the IP records experience and the eye for detail this role demands, please apply with your CV for a confidential discussion.

title: Legal Assistant
description:
Legal Assistant Bristol £25,000 + DOE 2 years' experience Enhanced annual leave package A new opportunity to join a firm known for its excellent working culture and reputation has just presented itself. title: Personal Injury Paralegal
description:
Personal Injury Case Handler
- Location: Bristol (Hybrid - 2 days in office)
- Job Type: Full-time

We are seeking an experienced Personal Injury Case Handler to join our client's claimant injury department. This role involves managing a diverse caseload of injury claims, including those involving vulnerable road users and minor to moderate head injury claims. The successful candidate will enjoy a balance of office and home working, contributing to our commitment to delivering high-quality legal services. MUST HAVE EXPERIENCE IN A LAW FIRM WORKING ON A PERSONAL INJURY LITIGATION CASELOAD. PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF THIS IS NOT THE CASE.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Efficiently and effectively manage your own caseload of personal injury claims.
- Pursue claims up to a value of £25,000 through and outside of the MOJ Portal, including pre and post-litigation stages, utilising our case management system.
- Ensure compliance with agreed service standards.
- Communicate effectively with clients, insurers, expert witnesses, and solicitors.
- Participate in weekly risk assessment meetings.
- Manage client expectations and address any complaints in line with company policy.
- Perform additional duties as required.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Proven experience handling a claimant injury caseload.
- Familiarity with MOJ Portal processes and claims allocated to the Fast Track.
- Experience in litigation, including the issue of proceedings and compliance with Court Directions through to Trial.
- Proficient in using a Case Management System.
- Ability to work to strict Service Level Agreements and handle claims including litigation.
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Strong analytical and legal research skills.
- Organisational and prioritisation abilities.
- Teamwork skills.
- Law degree, CILEx, or equivalent qualification is desirable but not essential.

Benefits:
- Competitive annual leave and welfare benefits.
- Health Cash Plan & Gym/Lifestyle Benefits.
- Emphasis on work-life balance and flexible working arrangements.
- People-focused recognition and referral schemes.
- Opportunities for professional development and routes to qualification.
- Commitment to diversity and sustainability.

We are dedicated to creating an accessible and inclusive recruitment experience. If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact our Talent Acquisition & Resourcing team.

To apply for this Personal Injury Case Handler position, please submit your CV and cover letter detailing your relevant experience.

title: Personal Injury Paralegal

Bristol

Salary up to £40,000 DOE

Yolk Recruitment is working with a national law firm looking to recruit an experienced Personal Injury Paralegal into its specialist Claimant Serious and Catastrophic Personal Injury team in Bristol.

This is a strong opportunity for an experienced personal injury professional who is already comfortable running their own litigated caseload and wants to develop further within serious injury work. The caseload will focus particularly on claims involving motor and vulnerable road users, including cyclists, motorcyclists and pedestrians.

This is what you will be doing

As a Personal Injury Paralegal, your duties and responsibilities will be:

- Previous experience independently managing a personal injury caseload.
- Experience handling claims involving motor and vulnerable road users.
